title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2019.

2.—(1) Dividends amounting to RM1,181,255 received in Singapore by S&P Global Asian Holdings Pte. Ltd. (a company incorporated in Singapore) from RAM Holdings Berhad (a company incorporated in Malaysia) in the basis periods for the years of assessment 2016 and 2017, are exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in paragraphs 4 and 5 of the letter of approval dated 1 February 2019 addressed to S&P Global Asian Holdings Pte. Ltd.
